title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Wanna Filter on Totals in Analysis Mode?

features.name: Filter totals in Analysis Mode
features.description: Ability to filter on aggregated or totaled columns in the data analysis feature, similar to filtering in normal reports. Users can apply conditions like 'greater than zero' to remove unwanted rows based on their summed amounts.

features.name: Save filtered analysis definition
features.description: Users can save their filtered analysis setup, including the totals filters they have applied, as part of their data analysis definition for reuse.
